notes.title: Remove From Sale
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everybody![/p][p]Due to changes in our business model, we will stop selling new copies of the game.
This has no effect on existing purchasers, The existing game will continue to function, and you will be able to continue playing as usual.[/p][p]We hope that you will continue to enjoy the game for years to come, Your continued trust and support mean the world to us![/p]
